title: Count the Number of Complete Components
goal: Count connected components in which every pair of different vertices has an edge.
strategy: Union graph endpoints, then count vertices and edges in each completed component. A simple component of size k is complete exactly when it has k times k minus one divided by two edges; an isolated vertex qualifies.
